title: STRIDE Threat Model Canvas
description: OWASP STRIDE threat modeling. Each threat requires provenance to distinguish hypothetical threats from observed ones.

category.description: STRIDE system-level category. Deliberately NOT a place for OWASP LLM ids: the two taxonomies are orthogonal, not alternatives (an indirect prompt injection is LLM01 AND tampering), so one field cannot hold both without making it uncountable. Use owasp_llm alongside.

owasp_llm.description: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications v2025 id, for model-level threats on agentic surfaces. Optional and INDEPENDENT of category — set both when a threat is both.
